gzhan gyi gnam por 'gyur nyid do/ /phung por bdag yod ma yin bdag la yang / /phung po de rnams yod min gang phyir 'dir/ /gzhan nyid yod na rtog pa 'dir 'gyur na/ /gzhan nyid de med de phyir 'di rtog pa'o/ /bdag ni gzugs ldan mi 'dod gang phyir bdag /yod min de phyir ldan don sbyor ba rnged—/ /gzhan na gnag ldan gzhan min gzugs ldan na/ /bdag ni gzugs las de nyid gzhan nyid med/ /gzugs bdag ma yin bdag ni gzugs ldan min/ /gzugs la bdag med bdag la'ang gzugs yod min/ /de ltar rnam bzhir phung kun shes bya ste/ /de dag bdag tu lta ba nyi shur 'dod//lta ri bdag med rtogs pa'i rdo rje yis/ /bcom bdag gang dang lhan cig 'jig 'gyur ba/ /'jig tshogs lta ri lhun stug la gnas pa/ /rtse mo mtho bar gyur pa 'di dag go/ /kha cig de nyid gzhan nyid rtag mi rtag /la sogs brjod med gang zag rdzas yod 'dod/ /rnam shes drug gi shes byar de 'dod cing / /de ni ngar 'dzin gzhir yang 'dod pa yin/ /gang phyir gzugs las sems brjod med mi rtogs/ /dngos yod brjod med rtogs pa ma yin nyid/ /gal te bdag 'ga' dngos por grub gyur na/ /sems ltar grub dngos brjod du med mi 'gyur/ /gang phyir spyod bum dngos por ma grub pa'i/ /ngo bo gzugs sogs las brjod med 'gyur bas/ /bdag gang phung po las brjod med 'gyur te/ /rang gis yod par grub par rtogs mi bya/ /khyod kyi rnam shes rang bdag las gzhan ni/ /mi 'dod gzugs sogs las gzhan dngos 'dod cing / /dngos la rnam pa de gnyis mthong 'gyur ba/ /de phyir bdag med dngos chos dang bral phyir/ /de phyir ngar 'dzin rten ni dngos po min/ /60—578

phung las gzhan min phung po'i ngo bo min/ /phung po rten min 'di ni de ldan min//'di ni phung po rnams brten 'grub par 'gyur/ /shing rta rang yan lag las gzhan 'dod min/ /gzhan min ma yin de ldan yang min zhing / /yan lag la min ①yan lag dag der min/ /'dus pa tsam min dbyibs min ji bzhin no/ /gal te tshogs tsam shing rtar 'gyur na ni/ /sil bur gnas la shing rta nyid yod 'gyur/ /gang phyir yan lag can med yan lag dag /med pas dbyibs tsam shing rtar rigs pa'ang min/ /khyod dbyibs yan lag re re sngar yod gyur/ /ji bzhin shing rtar gtogs la'ang de bzhin na/ /bye bar gyur pa de dag la ji ltar/ /da ltar yang ni shing rta yod ma yin/ /da lta gal te shing rta nyid dus ①'dir/ /'phang lo sogs la dbyebs tha dad yod na/ /'di gzung 'gyur na de yang yod min te/ /de phyir dbyibs tsam shing rtar yod ma yin/ /gang phyir khyod kyi tshogs pa cang med pas/ /dbyibs de yan lag tshogs kyi ma yin na/ /gang zhig ci yang ma yin de brten nas/ /'dir ni dbyibs su lta zhig ji ltar 'gyur/ /khyod kyi 'di ni ji ltar 'dod de ltar/ /mi bden pa yi rgyu la brten byas nas/ /'bras bu'i rnam pa mi bden rang bzhin can—/ /thams cad kyang ni skye bar shes par gyis/ /'dis ni gzugs sogs de ltar gnas rnams la/ /bum blo zhes bya'ang rigs pa ma yin nyid/ /skye ba med pas gzugs sogs kyang yod min/ /de yi phyir yang de dag dbyibs mi rigs/ /de ni de nyid du 'am ①'jig rten du/ /rnam pa bdun gyis 'grub 'gyur min mod kyi/ /rnam dpyad med par 'jig rten nyid las 'dir/ /rang gi yan lag brten nas 'dogs pa yin/ /de nyid yan lag can de cha shas 60—579

—can—/ /shing rta de nyid byed po zhes 'gror bsnyad/ /skye bo rnams la len po nyid du 'grub/ /'jig rten grags pa'i kun rdzob ma brlag cig /rnam bdun gyis med gang de ji lta bur/ /yod ces rnal 'byor pas 'di'i yod mi rnyed / /des de nyid la'ang bde blag 'jug 'gyur bas/ /'dir de'i grub pa de bzhin 'dod par bya/ /shing rta yod nyid yin ①na de yi tshe/ /yan lag can med de'i yan lag kyang med/ /shing rta tshig na yan lag med dpe bzhin/ /blo mes yan lag can bsregs yan lag go/ /de bzhin 'jig rten grags pas phung po dang / /khams dang de bzhin skye mched drug brten nas/ /bdag kyang nye bar len pa nyid du 'dod/ /nyer len las yin 'di ni byed po'ang yin/ /dngos yod min phyir 'di ni brtan min khru/zhing / /mi brtan nyid min 'di ni skye 'jig min/ /'di la rtag pa nyid la sogs pa yang / /yod min de nyid dang ni gzhan nyid min①/ /gang phyir ④rtag tu 'gro rnams ngar 'dzin blo/ /rab tu 'byung zhing de yi gang yin der/ /nga yir 'dzin blo 'byung ba'i bdag de ni/ /ma brtags phyegrags par gti mug las yin no/ /gang phyir byed po med can las med pa/ /de phyir bdag gi bdag med par yod min/ /de phyir bdag dang bdag gi stong lta zhing / /rnal 'byor pa de rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ /bum pa snam bu re lde dmag dang nags tshad phreng ba ljon shing dang / /khang khyem shing rta phran dang 'gron gnas la sogs dngos rnams gang dag dang / /de bzhin gang dag sgo nas skye 'dis bsnyad bupa de rnams rtogs bya ste/ /gang phyir thub dbang de ni 'jig rten lhan cig rtsod mi mdzad phyir ro/ /yan lag yon tan 'dod chags mtshan nyid dang ni bud shing la sogs dang / /yon tan can 60—580

yan lag can chags dang mtshan gzhi me la sogs don dag /de rnams shing rta'i rnam dpyad byas pas rnam bdun yod pa ma yin zhing / /de las gzhan du gyur par 'jig rten grags pa'i sgo nas yod pa yin/ /gal te rgyu yis bskyed par bya skyed ①de lta na de rgyu yin zhing / /gal te 'bras bu mi skyed na ni de med rgyu med can du 'gyur/ /'bras bu yang ni rgyu yod gyur na skye bar 'gyur ba de yi phyir—/ /gang las gang zhig 'gyur ba gang zhig las sngar gang zhig 'gyur ba smros//gal te khyod kyi rgyu yis phrad nas 'bras skyed byed na de yi tshe/ /de dag nus pa gcig pas skyed byed 'bras bu tha dad med 'gyur zhing / /so sor na ni rgyu 'di rgyu min rnams dang khyad par med 'gyur la/ /gnyis po 'di dag spangs nas rtog pa gzhan yang yod par 'gyur ma yin/ /ci ste khyod kyi rgyu yis 'bras bu skyed par mi byed de phyir 'bras/ /zhes bya yod min 'bras bral rgyu ni rgyu med can 'gyur yod pa'ang min/ /gang phyir 'di dag gnyis char yang ni sgyu ma dang 'dra de yi phyir/ /bdag la skyon du mi 'gyur 'jig rten pa yi dngos po rnams kyang yod/ /sun 'byin 'dis sun dbyung bya phrad nas 'byin nam ma phrad par/ /yin zhes nyes pa 'dir ni ②khyod la'ang 'gyur ba ma yin nam/ /gang tshe de skad smra zhing rang phyogs kho na rnam 'joms pa/ /de tshe khyod kyis sun dbyung sun ni 'byin par nus ma yin/ /gang phyir rang gi tshig la'ang thal ba mtshungs pa'i ltag chod kyis/ /rigs pa med par dngos mtha' dag la skur 'debs de yi phyir—/ /khyod ni skye bo dam pas bzhed mi 'gyur zhing gang gi 1phyir/ /khyod la rang phyogs med pas sun ci phyin du rgol ba'ang yin/ /sun 'byin pas sun dbyung bya ma phrad sun ni 'byin byed dam/ /'on te phrad nas yin zhes smras zin 60—581

nyes pa 'dir gang la/ /nges par phyogs yod de la 'gyur gyi bdag la phyogs 'di ni/ /yod pa min pas thal bar 'gyur ba 'di ni srid ma yin/ /ji ltar khyod kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yod khyad par rnams/ /gzugs brnyan la yang gzas bzung la sogs rnams tshe mthong 'gyur la/ /nyi ma dang ni gzugs brnyan rnam par phrad dang ma phrad par/ /mi rigs mod kyi brten nas tha snyad tsam zhig 'byung 'gyur zhing / /mi bden bzhin du'ang rang gi byad bzhin mdzes par bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /de ni yod pa ji ltar de bzhin 'dir yang shes rab gdong / /sbyang bar bya la nus pa mthong bar 'gyur ba'i gtan tshigs ni/ /'thad pa dang bral las kyang bsgrub bya rtogs zhes shes par bya①/ /gal te rang gi bsgrub bya go byed gtan tshigs dngos grub dang / /dngos su go bya nyid 'gyur bsgrub bya'i ngo bo'ang yod gyur na/ /phrad pa la sogs rigs pa nye bar sbyor bar 'gyur zhig na/ /de yang yod pa min pas khyed kyi yi chad 'ba' zhig yin/ /dngos rnams mtha' dag dngos po snemed par rtogs su gzhug ④par ni/ /zhus rtepar ches be+e ji la de ⑤ltar rang bzhin gzhan dag la/ /khong du chud par bde blag tu ni nus pa ma yin no/ /rtog ge ngan pa'i dra bas 'jig rten ci ste 'dir rtsol ༄ ṣ+pebyed/ /sun 'byin lhag ma gong du bstan pa yang ni shes byas nas/ /phrad pa la sogs phyogs kyi lan gyi ched du 'dir gtang bya/ /sun ci phyin du rgol ba pa yang ji ltar yod min pa/ /de skad sngar bshad lhag ma phyogs 'di nyid kyis rtogs ④par bya/ /bdag med 'di ni 'gro ba rnams ⑧dgrol phyir/ /chos dang gang zag dbye ba rnam gnyis gsungs/ /de ltar ston pas slar yang 'di nyid ni/ /gdul bya ⑨rnams la phye ste rnam mang ⑫gsungs/ /spros dang 60—582

bcas par stong pa nyid/ /bcu drug bshad nas ①mdor bsdus te/ /slar yang bzhir snebashad de dag ni/ /theg chen du yang bzhed pa yin/ /gang phyir de yi rang bzhin de/ /yin phyir mig ni mig gis stong / /de bzhin rna ba sna dang lce/ /lus dang yid kyis ①bsnyad par bya/ /ther zug gnas pa ma yin dang / /'jig pa ma yin nyid kyi phyir/ /mig la sogs pa drug po yi/ /rang bzhin med nyid gang yin pa/ /de ni nang stong nyid du 'dod/ /gang phyir de yi rang bzhin de/ /yin phyir gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong / /sgra dang dri ro reg bya dang / /chos rnams nyid kyang de bzhin no/ /gzugs sogs rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /phyi rol stong pa nyid du 'dod/ /gnyis char rang bzhin med nyid ni/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yin no/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa nyid—/ /mkhas pas stong pa nyid ces bsnyad/ /stong nyid de yang stong nyid kyi//ngo bos stong par 'dod pa yin/ /stong nyid ces rjobya'i stong nyid gang / /stong nyid stong nyid du 'dod de⑤/ /stong nyid dngos po'i blo can gyi/ /'dzin pa bzlog phyir gsungs pa yin/ /sems can snod kyi 'jig rten ni/ /ma lus khyab byed nyid phyir dang / /tshad med dpe rjoyis mu mtha' ni/ /med phyir phyogs rnams chen po nyid/ /'di dag bcu char phyogs rnams kyis/ /stong pa nyid ni gang yin de/ /chen po stong pa nyid yin de/ /chen por 'dzin pa bzlog phyir gsungs/ /de ni dgos pa mchog yin pas/ /don dam mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /de ni de yis stong nyid gang / /de ni don dam stong nyid de/ /myang 'das dngos po'i blo can gyi/ /'dzin pa bzlog par bya ba'i phyir/ /don dam mkhyen pas don dam pa/ /stong pa nyid ni bstan par mdzad/ /rkyen las 60—583

byung phyir khams gsum po/ /'dus byas yin par nges par bsnyad/ /de ni de yis lhastong nyid gang / /de ni 'dus byas stong nyid gsungs/ /gang la skye gnas mi rtag nyid/ /de dag med pa 'dus ma byas/ /de ni de ①yis stong nyid sa/nga / /de ni 'dus ma byas stong nyid/ /gang la mtha' ni yod min pa/ /de ni mtha' las 'das par brjod/ /de de kho nas stong pa nyid/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong nyid bsnyad/ /thog ma dang po tha ma mtha'/ /de dag med pas 'khor ba ni/ /thog ma tha ma med par brjod/ /'gro 'ong bral phyir rmi lam lta'i/ /srid 'di de yis dben nyid gang / /de ni thog ma dang tha ma/ /med pa stong pa nyid do zhes/ /bstan bcos las ni nges par bsnyad/ /dor ba ces ④bya 'thor ba dang / /'bor ba la ni nges par brjod/ /dor dhimed gtong ba med pa ste/ /'ga' yang dor med gang yin pa'o/ /dor ba med pa de nyid kyis/ /de nyid stong pa nyid gang yin/ /de de'i phyir na dor med pa/ /stong pa nyid ces bya bar brjod/ /'dus byas la sogs ngo bo nyid/ /gang phyir slob ma rang sangs rgyas/ /rgyal sras de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /ma mdzad de'i phyir 'dus byas la/ /sogs pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /rang bzhin nyid du bsnyad pa ste/ /de nyid kyis de stong nyid gang / /de ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /khams bco brgyad dang reg drug dang / /de las byung ba'i tshor drug dang / /gzugs can gzugs can min de bzhin/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas chos rnams/ /chos de dag ni thams cad kyi/ /de dag gis dben stong nyid gang / /gzugs rung la sogs dngos med gang / /de no rang mtshan stong pa nyid/ /gzugs ni gzugs rung mtshan nyid can/ /tshor ba myong ba'i 60—584

bdag nyid can/ /'du shes mtshan mar 'dzin pa ste/ /'du byed mngon par 'du byed pa'o/ /yul la so sor rnam rig pa/ /rnam shes rang gi mtshan nyid do—/ /phung po sdug bsngal rang mtshan nyid/ /khams kyi bdag nyid sprul gdug 'dod—/ /skye mched rnams ni sangs rgyas kyis/ /skye ba'i sgor gyur nyid du gsungasaske/ /rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba gang / /de ni 'du 'phrod mtshan nyid do/ /gtong ba sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /tshul khrims gdung med mtshan nyid bzod/ /khro med mtshan nyid brtson 'grus kyi/ /kha na ma tho med nyid do/ /bsam gtan sdud pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /shes rab chags med mtshan nyid de/ /pha rol phyin pa drug rnams kyi/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag yin par brjod/ /bsam gtan rnams dang tshad med dang / /de bzhin gzhan gang gzugs med pa//de dag yang dag mkhyen pa yis/ /mi 'khrug ①mtshan nyid can du gsungs/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /nges par 'byung byed rang mtshan nyid/ /stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /dmigs pa med pas rnam dbe+en nyid/ /mtshan ma med pa zhi nyid de/ /gsum pa'i mtshan nyid sdug bsngal dang / /gti mug med rnam thar rnams kyi/ /mtshan nyid rnam par grol byed pa'o/ /stobs rnams shin tu rnam par ni/ /gtan la 'be+ebs pa'i rang bzhin gsungs//skyob pa'i mi 'jigs pa rnams ni/ /shin tu brtan pa'i ngo bo yin/ /so sor yang dag rig rnams na②/ /spobs sogs tshad med mtshan nyid can/ /'gro la phan pa nyer sgrub pa/ /byams pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /sdug bsngal can rnams yongs skyob pa/ /thugs rje chen po'o dga' ba ni/ /rab dga'i mtshan nyid btang snyoms ni/ /ma 'dres mtshan nyid can zhes ①bya/ /sangs rgyas 60—585

chos ni ma 'dres pa/ /bcu dang brgyad du gang 'dod dag /gang phyir sten ①des mi 'phrogs pa/ /de phyir mi 'phrogs rang mtshan nyid/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes ni/ /mngon sum mtshan nyid can du 'dod/ /gzhan ni nyi tshe ba nyid kyi/sa/ /mngon sum zhes byar mi 'dod do/ /gang zhig 'dus byas mtshan nyid dang / /'dus ma byas pa'i mtshan nyid gang / / re re ②kho nas stong pa nyidaske/ /de ni rang mtshan stong pa nyid/ /da lta ba 'di mi gnas shing / /'das dang ma 'ongs yod ma yin/ /gang du de dag mi dmigs pa/ /de la mi dmigs pa zhes brjod/ /mi dmigs pa de rang ngo bo/ /de yis dben pa nyid gang de/ /ther zug gnas min 'jig min pas④/ /mi dmigs zhes bya'i stong nyid do/ /rkyen las byung phyir dngos rnams la/ /'dus pa pa yi ngo bo med/ /'dus pa pa ni de nyid kyis/ /stong nyid dngos med stong nyid do/ /dngos po'i sgras ni mdor bsdus na/ /phung po lnga rnams brjod pa yin/ /de rnams de yis stong nyid gang / /de dngos stong pa nyid du bshad/ /mdor bsdus na ni dngos med pa/ /'dus ma byas chos rnams la brjod/ /de nyid dngos med nges stong nyid/ /dngos po med pa stong nyid do/ /rang bzhin ngo bo nyid med ni/ /rang bzhin zhes bya'i stong nyid de/ /'di ltar rang bzhin ma byas pas/ /rang bzhin zhes ni bya bar bsnyad/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung ba'am/ /ma byung yang rung dngos su na/ /dngos po kun gyi stong pa nyid//gzhan byi dngos por rab tu bsgrags/ /yang dag mtha' dang de bzhin nyid/ /de bzhin ④dngos po'i stong nyid do/ /shes rab pha rol phyin tshud las/ /de dag de skad rab tu bsgrags/ /de ltar blo gros zer gyis snang ba gsal byas pa/ /60—586

rang gi lag na gnas pa'i skyu ru ra bzhin du/ /srid gsum 'di dag ma lus gdod nas skye med par/ /rtogs te tha snyad bden pa'i stobs kyis 'gog par 'gro—/ /rtag tu 'gog par gtogs pa'i bsam gtan yin mod kyi/ /'gro ba mgon med pa la snying rje'ang skyed par byed/ /de gong bde gshegs gsung skyes sangs rgyas 'bring bcas ni/ /ma lus pa rnams blo yis pham par byed pa'ang yin/ /kun rdzob de nyid gshog yangs dkar po rgyas gyur pa/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po de ni skye bo'i ngang pa yis/ /mdun du bdar nas dge ba'i rlung gi shugs stobs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol mchog tu 'gro/ /dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ sems bskyed pa drug pa'o// //ring du song 'dir 'di ni skad cig dang / /skad cig la ni 'gog par 'jug 'byung ①zhing / /thabs kyi pha rol phyin legs 'bar ba'ang 'thob /dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ sems bskyed pa bdun pa'o// //yang yang sngar dge las lhag thob bya'i phyir/ /gang du phyir mi ldog pa nyid 'gyur ba/ /mi g.yo de la bdag nyid che de 'jug /'di yi spyon lam shin tu dag 'gyur zhing / /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'gog las slong bar mdzad/ /chags pa med pa'i blo ni skyon rnams dag dang lhan cig mi gnas phyir/ /sa brgyad pa la dri ma de dag rtsa bcas nye bar zhi 'gyur zhing / /nyon mongs zad cing sa gsum bla mar gyur kyang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /'byor pa mkha' ltar mtha' bral ma lus 'thob par nus ma yin/ /'khor ba 'gags kyang dbang rnams 60—587

bcu po thob par 'gyur zhing de dag gis/ /srid pa'i 'gro bar rang gi bdag nyid sna tshogs ston par byed par 'gyur/ /dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ sems bskyed pa brgyad pa'o// //dgu pa la ni de'i stobs lta zhig mtha' dag rdzogs par dag 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin yang dag rig chos rang gi yon tan yongs su dag pa'ang 'thob/ /dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ sems bskyed pa dgu pa'o// //bcu pa'i sa la de yis kun nas sangs rgyas rnams las dbang bskur ba/ /dam pa 'thob cing ye shes lhag par mchog tu byung bar gyur pa'ang ①yin/ /char sprin rnams las chu char 'bab pa ji ltar de bzhin 'gro rnams kyi/ /dge ba'i lo tog ched du rgyal sras las kyang lhun grub chos char 'bab/ /dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ sems bskyed pa bcu pa'o// //de tshe 'dis ni sangs rgyas brgya mthong zhing / /de dag byen gye ②brlabs kyang 'di yis rtogs/ /de nyid tshe na bskal pa brgyar gnas shing / /sngon dang phyi ma'i mthar yang yang dag 'jug /blo ldan ting 'dzin brgya phrag snyoms par 'jug cing gtong byed de/ /'jig rten khams brgya 'di yis kun nas g.yo zhing snang bar nus/ /de bzhin rdzu 'phrul gyis de sems can brgya phrag zin byed cing / /brgya phrag grangs dang rjes 'byel zhing dag tu yang 'gro bar 'gyur—/ /des ni chos kyi sgo rnams yang dag 'byed byed thub dbang sras/ /60—588

rang gi lus la lus rnams kun nas ston par byed pa'ang yin/ /rang gi 'khor dang bcas pas mdzes 'byor lus ni re re zhing / /rgyal ba'i sras po brgya phrag dag dang rjes su 'brel ba'ang ston/ /blo ldan rab tu dga' bar gnas pas yon tan de dag ni/ /thob par gyur nas de bzhin kho nar dri ma med gnas pas//de dag stong ni yang dag 'thob par 'gyur te sa lnga po/ /'di dag rnams la byang chub sems dpa' yis ni 'bum phrag dang / /bye ba phrag brgya 'thob cing de yis bye ba stong 'gyur 'thob/ /de nas bye ba brgya phrag stong 'gyur yang 'thob bye ba phrag /khrag khrig phrag ①brgyar rdzogs par bsgrub kyedang be+er yang stong phrag tu//yang dag par ni bsgyur ba mtha' dag rab tu 'thob par 'gyur/ /mi g.yo'i sar gnas rnam rtog med pa des/ /stong gsum brgya phrag stong bsdoms 'jig rten na/ /rdul tshad ji snyed yod pa de rnams dang / /grangs mnyam yon tan dag ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /legs pa'i blo gros sa la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems des sngar bstan yon tan dag /grangs med brgya phrag stong du yang dag par/ /bsdoms pa phrag bcu'i rdul tshad thob par 'gyur/ /re zhig bcu pa 'dir de'i yon tan dag /ngag gi spyod yul las ches 'das 'gyur zhing / /ngag gi spyod yul ma yin bsdoms rnams na/ /rdul dag ji snyed yod pa de snyed 'gyur—/ /ba spu'i khung bur byang chub sems rnams dang / /lhan cig rdzogs sangs rgyas sku bgrang 'das dang / /de bzhin lha dang lha min mi dag kyang / /skad cig skad cig la ni ston par nus/ /gang phyir nam mkha' dri ma med la zla snang gsal bar gyur pa'i phyir/ /sngon tshe stobs bcu bskyed pa'i sa la khyod kyis slar yang 'bad gyur zhing 1/ /'og min du ni gang gi don du 'bad gyur go 60—589

'phang mchog zhi ba/ /yon tan mtha' dag mthar thug mtshungs pa med de khyed kyis brnyes/ /ji ltar snod kyi dbye bas mkha' la dbye ba med de ltar/ /dngos byas dbye ba 'ga' yang de nyid la med de yi phyir/ /ro mnyam nyid du yang dag thugs su chud par ①mdzad gyur na/ /mkhyen bzang khyod kyis skad cig gis no shes bya thugs su chud/ /gang tshe zhi ba de nyid yin na de la blo gros 'jug mi 'gyur/ /blo ma zhugs par shes bya'i yul can nges par rigs pa'ang ②ma yin la/ /kun nas shes med pa ni shes par ji ltar 'gyur te 'gal bar 'gyur—/ /mkhyen po med par khyed kyis gzhan la 'di lta'o zhes su zhig ston/ /gang tshe skye med de nyid yin zhing blo yang skye ba dang bral ba/ /de tshe de rnams sten a+yo las de yis de nyid rtogs pa lta bu ste/ /ji ltar sems ni gang gi rnam pa can du 'gyur ba de yis yul/ /de yongs shes pa de bzhin tha snyad brten nas rig ④pa yin—/ /de yi longs spyod rdzogs sku bsod nams kyis/ /zin dang sprul pa mkha' gzhan las de'i mthus/ /sgra gang chos kyi de nyid ston 'byung ba/ /de las 'jig rten gyis kyang de nyid rig /ji ltar rdza mkhan stobs chen ldan pas 'dir—/ /yun ring ches 'bad pas bskor 'khor lo ni/ /de'i rtsol da ltar skyes pa med bzhin du'ang / /'khor zhing bum pa la sogs rgyur mthong ltar/ /de bzhin da lta skyes rtsol med bzhin du/ /chos kyi bdag can sku nyid la bzhugs de'i—/ /'jug pa skye bo'i dge dang smon lam gyi/ /khyad par gyis 'phangs las ches bsam mi khyab/ /shes bya'i bud shing skam po ma lus pa/ /bsregs pas zhi de rgyal rnams chos sku ste/ /de tshe skye ba med cing 'gag pa med/ /sems 'gags pas de sku yis mngon sum mdzad/ /zhi sku dpag bsam shing 60—590

ltar gsal gyur zhing ①/ /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin rnam mi rtog /'gro grol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad rtag /'di ni spros dang bral la snang bar 'gyur / /thub dbang dus gcig kho nar de'i rgyu mthun/ /gzugs sku gcig la rang gi skye gnas skabs/ /sngar 'gags gsal dang ma 'chol byung tshul ni/ /ma lus kyis bkra mtha' dag ston par mdzad/ /sangs rgyas zhing ji 'drar thub dbang de dang / /de dag sku spyod mthu stobs ji 'dra dang / /nyan thos dge 'dun ji snyed ji lta dang / /byang chub sems rnams der gzugs ji 'dra dang / /ji 'dra'i chos dang der bdag ji 'dra dang / /chos thos spyod pa gang la spyad pa dang / /sbyin gang ji tsam de dag la phul ba/ /de ni ma lus sku gcig la ston mdzad—/ /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod brtson ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab spyod tshe sngar kyi gnas skabs gang / /ma tshang med de dag nyid spyod pa kun/ /sku yi ba spu'i khung bur 'ang gsal bar ston/ /sangs rgyas gang dag 'das dang 'byung 'gyur gang / /gang dag da ltar nam mkha'i mthar thug par/ /gdangs mthon chos ston sdug bsngal gyis bzung ba'i/ /'gro dbugs 'byin zhing 'jig rten bzhugs pa dang / /dang po'i thugs bzung byang chub snying po'i bar—/ /de dag spyod kun dngos rnams mig 'phrul gyi/ /rang bzhin mkhyen nas bdag bzhin ba spu yi/ /khung bur dus gcig la ni gsal bar ston/ /de bzhin dus gsum byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal 'phags pa nyan thos ma lus kyi/ /spyod dang de lhag skye bo'i gnas skabs ni/ /thams cad ba spu'i khung bur gcig tshe ston/ /dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yis/ /rdul gcig yul ②la mkha' gtugs 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten mtha' yas 60—591

phyogs khyab rdul ston mod/ /rdul rags mi 'gyur 'jig rten phra mi 'gyur/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' khyod kyis srid mtha'i bar/ /skad cig de re re la spyod sna tshogs—/ /ji snyed ston pa de snyed 'dzam bu gling / /ma lus rdul gang de snyed la grangs med/ /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen stobs dang / /de bzhin las rnam le smin blo dang / /mos pa sna tshogs thugs chud dang / /sna tshogs khams ni mkhyen stobs dang / /de bzhin dbang mchog mchog ma yin/ /mkhyen dang thams cad du 'gro dang / /bsam gtan rnam thar ting 'dzin dang / /snyoms par 'jug sogs blo stobs dang / /sngon gnas dran pa mkhyen pa dang / /de bzhin 'chi 'pho skye blo dang / /zag rnams zad pa mkhyen stobs te/ /stobs ni bcu po 'di dag go/ /rgyu gang zhig las gang zhig nges par skye 'gyur ba/ /de ni de yi gnas su de mkhyen rnams kyis gsungs/ /bshad pa las bzlog ②gnas min ④shes bya mtha' yas pa/ /mkhyen pa thogs pa spangs pa de ni stobs su bshad/ /'dod dang mi 'dod de las bzlog dang zad dudangos kyi/ /las dang de yi rnam smin shin tu sna tshogs la'ang / /mkhyen pa nus mthu thogs med so sor 'jug 'gyur ba/ /dus gsum shes bya khyab mdzad de ni stobs su 'dod//'dod chags sogs kyis 'byung ba'i stobs kyis 'dod pa ni/ /shin tu sna tshogs dman 'bring gang yang khyad 'phags 'dod/ /de las gzhan rnams kyis g.yogs mos la ⑤mkhyen pa ni/ /dus gsum 'gro ba ma lus khyab pa stobs shes 4bya—/ /sangs rgyas khams kyi rnam par dbye la mkhas rnams kyis⑦/ /mig sogs rnams kyi rang bzhin gang de khams su gsungs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mkhyen pa mtha' yas shing / /rnam kun khams kyi khyad par la 'jug 60byed592

stobs su 'dod/ /kun tu rtog ①sogs ches rno nyid ni mchog bzhed la/ /'bring gnas skabs dang rtul nyid mchog min par bshad dang / /mig la sogs dang phan tshun sgrub nus chub pa la/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa chags med stobs su gsungs/ /lam 'ga' rgyal ba nyid dang 'ga' zhig rang rgyal gyi/ /byang chub dang ni nyan thos byang chub yi dwags dang / /dud 'gro lha mi rnams dang dmyal ba sogs 'gro ba/ /de la mkhyen pa chags med mtha' yas stobs su 'dod—/ /'jig rten mtha' yas rnal 'byor bye brag la tha dad/ /bsam gtan rnam thar brgyad gang ①zhi gnas gang dag dang / /snyoms 'jug khyad par gang dag gcig par ④brgyad gyur pa/ /de la mkhyen pa thogs med 'di ni stobs su bshad/ /ji srid gti mug de srid srid gnas 'das bdag dang / /sems can gzhan re re yi srid pa sems can ni/ /ji snyed de snyed mtha' yas gzhir dhibacas yul phyogs dang / /bcas rnams la blo gang dang gang yin stobs su bshad/ /sems can rnams kyi sems can re re'i 'chi 'pho dang / /skye gang 'jig rten la gnas nam mkha' rjomathar thug dang / /bkra mang de la mkhyen pa dus der 'jug pa yis/ /ma chags rnam kun yongs dag mtha' yas stobs su 'dod/ /rnam kun mkhyen pa'i stobs kyis myur du rgyal rnams kyi/ /nyon mongs dag ni bag pyachags dang bcas 'jig 'gyur dang / /slob ma la sogs nyon mongs blo yis 'gog pa gang / /de la mkhyen pa chags med mtha' yas stobs su 'dod/ /nam mkha' med pas 'dab chags ldog par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'di ④ni rang mthu zad pas ldog par 'gyur de bzhin/ /slob ma dang bcas sangs rgyas sras rnams sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan mkha' ltar mtha' yas ma 60byed593

brjod ldog par 'gyur/ /de phyir bdag 'dras khrod yon 'di dag ci/ /shes pa dang ni brjod par nus 'gyur ram/ /'on kyang de dag 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis / /bshad phyir dogs spangs cung zhig tsam zhig smras/ /zab mo stong pa nyid yin te/ /yon tan gzhan rnams rgya che ba'o/ /zab dang rgya che'i tshul shes pas/ /yon tan 'di dag 'thob ①par 'gyur/ /slar yang mi g.yo sku mnga' khyod kyis srid gsum byon nas sprul rnams kyis/ /gshegs pa dang ni bltam dang byang chub zhi ba'i 'khor lo'ang ston par mdzad/ /de ltar khyod ②kyis 'jig rten g.yo bag spyod can re ba'i zhags ⑦pa ni/ /mang pos bcings pa ma lus thugs rjes mya ngan 'das par bkri bar mdzad/ /gang phyir 'di na de nyid shes las dri ma mtha' dag sel ba ni/ /lhur byed gzhan med chos rnams de nyid rnam 'gyur dbye la'ang bsten min zhing / /de nyid yul can blo gros 'di yang tha dad 'gyur ba ma yin larjo/ /de yi phyir na khyed kyis 'gro la theg pa mi mnyam dbyer med bstan/ /gang phyir 'gro la nyes pa skyed byed snyigs ma 'di dag yod gyur pa/ /de phyir 'jig rten sangs rgyas spyod yul gting zab la 'jug mi 'gyur zhing / /bde gshegs gang phyir khrod la mkhyen rab thugs rje thabs dang lhan cig pa/ /mnga' dang gang phyir bdag gis sems can dgrol zhes khyod kyis zhal bzhes te/ /de phyir mkhas pa rin po che yi gling du chas pa'i skye tshogs kyi/ /ngal ba nyer sel grong khyer yid 'ong bar du rnam par bkod pa ltar—/ /khyod kyis theg pa 'di ni slob ma nye bar zhi ba'i tshul la yid/ /sbyar zhing rnam par dbe+en la'ang blo sbyangs rnams la logs su gsungs/ /bde bar gshegs pa ma lus phyogs shing ⑤sangs rgyas yul dag na/ /phra rab rdul gyi rdul 60byed594

rnams bdog par gyur pa ji snyed pa/ /byang chub mchog rab dam par gshegs pa'i skal ba de snyed de/ /'on kyang khyod kyi gsang ba 'di ni bsnyad ①bgyi ma lags so/ /rgyal ba ji srid 'jig rten mtha' dag mchog tu rab zhi bar/ /'gro ba min zhing nam mkha' rnam 'jig 'gyur min de srid du/ /shes rab yum gyis bskyed pa khyod la thugs brtse ma ma yis/ /tshul lugs byed pas rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba gang la mnga'/ /gti mug skyon gyis 'jig rten kha zas dug bcas za ba yi/ /skye bo nyid kyi nang mi de la khyed brtse ji lta ba/ /de ltar dug zos nyen pa'i bu la ma yi sdug bsngal min/ /des na mgon po mchog tu rab zhir gshegs par 'gyur ma lags/ /gang gi phyir na mi mkhas dngos dang dngos med par zhen pa yi blo can gyis/ /skye dang 'jig gnas skabs dang sdug dang mi sdug bral phrad kyis bskyed sdug bsngal dang / /sdig can 'gro ba 'thob pa de phyir 'jig rten thugs brtse'i yul du rab dong bas/ /bcom ldan thugs rjes khyod thugs sdezhi las bzlog pas khyod la mya ngan 'das mi mnga'/ /lugs 'di dge slong zla grags kyis/ /dbu ma'i bstan bcos las btus nas/ /lung ji bzhin dang man ngag ni/ /ji lta ba bzhin brjod pa yin/ /'di las gzhan na chos 'di ni/ /ji ltar med pa de bzhin du/ /'dir 'byung lugs kyang gzhan na ④ni/ /med ces mkhas rnams nges par mdzod/ /klu sgrub blo mtsho shin tu rgya che'i kha dog gis 'jigs pas/ /skye bos lugs bzang gang dag rgyang ring spangs pas de yi tshig /le'ur byas pa'i kha 'bus ku mu ta rgekha phye ba'i chus—/ /da lta zla ba grags pa re rnams rab tu skong bar byed/ /de nyid bshad zin zab mo 'jigs rung 'di ni sngon goms nyid las skye bo yis/ /nges 60—595

par rtogs 'gyur 'di ni gsan rgya che yang gzhan gyis thugs su chud mi 'gyur/ /de phyir tshul lugs rang blos sbyar ba 'di dag mthong nas bdag tu brjod pa yi/ /gzhung lugs rnams ltar gzhan lugs bzhed gzhung 'di las gzhan la dga' blo dor bar bya/ /slob dpon klu sgrub lugs bzang bsnyad las bdag gis bsod nams phyogs kyi mthar/ /khyab cing yid mkha' nyon mongs kyis sngor ston ka'i rgyu skar ltar dkar ba'am/ /sems kyi ①sgrul la gdengs ka'i nor bu dang 'dra gang zhig thob pa des/ /'jig rten ma lus de nyid rtogs nas myur du bde 1gshegs sar bgrod shog /dbu ma la 'jug pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i tshul gsal kyebar byed pa/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa theg pa mchog la thugs gzhol ba/ mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje mnga' ba/ ri mor bris pa'i ba drus ④las 'o ma bzhos pas bden par zhen pa bzlog par mdzad pas sbyar ba rdzogs so// //kha che'i yul byi grong khyen dpe med kyi dbung / rin chen sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang du/ kha che'i rgyal po dpal 'phags pa lha'i sku ring la/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ti la ka dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba ban+de pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis kha che'i dpe dang mthun par bsgyur/ phyis ra sa ra mo cher rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang / lots+tsha snyeb de nyid kyis nyi 'og shar phyogs pa'i dpe dang gtugs shing legs par bcos te gtan la phab pa'o// //'dir 'grel pa'i mdzad byang dang / 'gyur byang gi steng nas thun mong ba rnams bkod pa ni/ rtsa ba logs su bsgyur ba dang 'grel pa'i nang gi rtsa ba gnyis sbyar nas zhus dag byas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no// //60—596

591 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉ceng / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gul/592 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rnams/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉zlog ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉zas ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'ang / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉smonas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ste)/593 ①〈〈co 〉mnyags/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pathar brgyad/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dang / du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bzhir/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉slobakha'i/ du〈〈snar 〉〉〉ma/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradir/594 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thob/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉khyed/ ③〈〈pe 〉smonabs/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stanang /595 ①〈〈snar 〉〉 na/ ②〈〈snar 〉starje'i khyod lugs/ ④〈〈snar 〉mi na/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉da/596 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bder/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsal du〈〈pe〉〉 ma ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉glo tsā/bsdur 'bras re'u migadasge ma/ (39)60wa 599

na090༄ga /dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bshad pa zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ mā ①sgye ma ka a 3ba tā ra bhā 6 ④nā ma/bod skad du/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bshad pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu ma'i bstan bcos la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/ dbu ma la 'jug pa rtsom par 'dod pas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams pas kyang thog mar/bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po sangs rgyas nyid kyi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa dang po/sems can 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa skyabs med pa dpag tu med pa ma lus pa yongs su skyob pa'i mtshan nyid can la bstod par 'os pa nyid du bstan pa'i phyir/ nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing / /snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes bya ba la 60byed600

sogs pa tshigs su bcad pa gnyis smos so/ /de la gong na med pa'i chos kyi dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa mnga' bas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams pas kyang dbang phyug dam pa phun sum tshogs pa nyid dang / nyan thos la sogs pa rnams de'i bkas mnga' bsgyur ba'i phyir/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la thub dbang zhes bya'o/ /de rnams las nyan thos la sogs pa dag skyes pa ni de dag las bsgrun pa'o/ /ji ltar zhe na/sangs rgyas rnams byung bar gyur pa na rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba phyin ci ma log pa ston pa la 'jug pa'i phyir la/ de nyan pa dang sems pa dang sgom ①pa'i rim pa las kyang lhag par mos pa ji lta ba bzhin nyan thos la sogs pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te yang kha cig gis rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba nye bar bstan pa nyan pa kho na las don dam pa rtogs pa la mkhas su zin kyang mthong ba'i skye ba ④kho na la mya ngan las 'das pa srithob par mi 'gyur mod kyi/ de lta na yang nye bar ston 0pa'i sgrub pa po dag gis las rnam par smin par ⑤nges pa'i 'bras bu ltar tshe rabs gzhan du mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu yongs su smin pa gor ma chag buthob par 'gyur ro/ /ji skad du 'phags pa lhas/ de nyid shes pas gal te 'dir/ /mya ngan 'das pa ma thob kyang / /skye ba gzhan du 'bad med par/ /nges par thob 'gyur las bzhin no//zhes bshad do/ /de nyid kyi phyir dbu ma las kyang / rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams ma byung zhing / /nyan thos rnams kyang zad pa na/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni/ /rten ⑦pa med par rab tu 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /de la yang dag pa'i gdams ⑧ngag gi 'bras bu thob par byed pas na nyan thos dag ste/60—601

'di ltar bya ba byas so/ /'di las srid pa gzhan mi shes so zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'byung ba yin no/ /yang na 'bras bu'i mchog gam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las thos nas de ①don du gnyer ba rnams la sgogs par byed pas na nyan thos dag ste/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las/ mgon po de ring bdag cag nyan thos gyur/ /byang chub dam pa yang dag bsgrags ②par babyi/ /byang chub pa yi sgra yang rab tu brjod—/ /de bas bdag cag nyan thos mi zad sne'adra/ /zhes ji skad gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang de lta dhiyin mod kyi/ de lta na yang sgogs par byed pa nyid yin gyi rjes su mthun pa tsam yang mi sgrub pa gang yin pa de dag nyan thos yin pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ⑤thal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi sgra 'di sangs rgyas kyi mede nyid nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsum car ⑦la yang 'jug ste/ des na sangs rgyas kyi ④sgras rang sangs rgyas dag bsnyad do/ /de dag ni bsod nams dang ye shes gong du 'phel ba'i khyad par rmis nyan thos rnams las khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang thugs rje chen po dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa la sogs pa med pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams pas dman pa'i phyir na 'bring ngo / /de nyid kyi phyir de dag ni nye bar ma bstan par ye shes 'byung zhing bdag nyid gcig pu'i phyir rang nyid sangs rgyas pas rang sangs rgyas so/ /ji skad bshad pa'i tshul gyes nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas chos bstan pa las nges par byung ⑨ba nyid kyi ⑩phyir thub dbang 60byed602

las skyes so/ /yang thub pa'i dbang po de rnams gang las bltams she ①na/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing / /zhes bya ba smos so/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pas nye bar bstan pa las skyes par gyur pas rgyal ba'i sras zhes brjod pa ma yin nam/ de'i phyir ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs she na/ 'di ni bden mod kyi 'on kyang rgyu gnyis kyis byang chub sems dpa' dag ②sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rgyur 'gyur te/ gnas skabs kyi ①khyad par dang / yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa las so/ /de la gnas skabs kyi khyad par las ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas skabs ni byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs kyi rjorgyu can yin pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa las ni ji ltar 'phags pa 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpar gyur pa nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang / de las gzhan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ches thog ma kho nar byang chub kyi sems yang dag par 'dzin du bcug par 'dod ⑤pa yin no/ /de'i phyir de ltar 'bras bu mthar thug pa de'i rgyu gtso bor gyur pa la khyeltos nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs par bstan to/ /de nyid kyi phyir rgyu phun sum tshogs pa ches brling ba yin pa'i phyir la/ rgyu la mchod pa brjod pas kyang 'bras bu la mchod pa don gyes 'phangs par dgongs te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sman gyi ljon shing chen po 'bras bu nges pa dpag tu med pa ster ba/ myu ⑦gu la sogs ⑧mtho zhing lo ma 'jam pa'i gnas skabs su gyur pa ltar bsgrims te yongs su bskyang bar bya ba nyid du bstan par bya zhing / dus 60—603

der nye bar gyur cing ①theg pa gsum la bkod pa'i sems can byi phung po theg pa chen po nyid la nges par sbyar bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bsngags pa mdzad pa yin no/ /ji skad du 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ 'od srungs 'di lta ste dper na zla ba tshes pa la phyag 'tshal ba ltar nya ba la ni ma yin no/ /'od srungs de bzhin du gang dag nga la rab tu dad pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag bya'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ni de lta ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams las ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad byung ngo zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de'i phyir de ltar na rigs pa dang lung dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs pa yin no zhes bya ba 'di bsgrubs pa yin no/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' de dag ci'i phyir ④rgyu can zhig yin zhe na/snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes bya ba smos so/ /de la snying rje ni brtse ba ste/ 'di nyid du 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rnam pa dang rang gi ngo bo can no/ /gnyis su med pa'i blo ni/ dngos po dang dngos po med pa la sogs pa mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i shes rab po/ /byang chub kyi sems ni 'phags pa chos kun bgro ba'i mdo las—/ byang chub sems dpas byang chub kyi sems las chos thams cad khong du chud par bgyi'o/ /chos thams cad ni chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'o/ /glo bur du byung ba mi gnas pa chos thams cad ni shes par bgyi ba tsam dang /shes pa pos stong pa'i phyir yongs su shes par bgyi ba tsam du bas na chos nyid 60—604

'di lta bu 'di sems can rnams kyis khong du chud par bya'o snyam nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la sems gang skyes pa ①'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang / bla na med pa'i sems dang / byams pas mnyen pa'i sems dang / snying rjes mi zlog pa'i sems dang / dga' bas 'gyod pa ma mchis pa'i sems dang / btang snyoms kyis ④dri ma ma mchis pa'i sems dang /stong pa nyid kyis mi 'gyur ba'i sems dang / mtshan ma ma mchis pas sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i sems dang / spyon pa ma mchis pas mi gnas pa'i sems zhes ji skad bstan pa bzhin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gtso bo'i rgyu ni snying rje dang / gnyis su med pa'i shes rab dang / byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba chos gsum po 'di dag yin no/ /ji skad du rin po che'i phreng ba las/ de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang / /phyogs mtha' sne gtugs ba'i snying rje dang / /gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gnyis kyi rtsa ba yang snying rje yin pa'i phyir na snying rje gtso bo nyid du bstan par 'dod pas/gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal ba'i lo thog phun tshogs 'di'i/ /sa bon dang ni spel la chur rjo'adra yun ring du/ /longs spyod gnas la smin pa lta bur 'dod gyur pa—/ /de phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rje bstod par bgyi/ /zhes bya ba ⑤smos so—/ /ji ltar phyi rol kyi 0'bru la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ thog ma dang bar dang tha ma rnams su sa bon dang chu dang smin pa rnams gtso bo nyid du gyur pas nye bar mkho ba nyid yin pa de bzhin du/ snying rje kho na dus gsum car ⑦60—605

du yang rgyal ba'i lo thog phun sum tshogs pa la nye bar mkho ba nyid du ston pa yin no—/ /'di ltar snying rje can ni gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba nyid kyis sems can sdug bsngal bar gyur pa ma lus pa yongs su bskyab par bya ba'i phyir—/ gdon mi za bar bdag gis 'jig rten 'di mtha' dag sdug bsngal nas bton te/ sangs rgyas nyid la nges par sbyar bar bya'o snyam du nges par sems skyed ①par byed do/ /dam bca' ba 'di yang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spangs pas sgrub par mi nus pas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la yang nges pa kho nar 'jug ste/ de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon ni snying rje nyid yin no/ /ji skad du rin po che'i phreng ba las/ theg pa chen po gang zhig las②—/ /snying rje sngon btang spyod pa kun/ /ye shes dri ma med bshad pa/ /sems yod su zhig de la smodasne/ /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems bskyed du zin kyang / gal te dus phyis snying rje'i chus yang dang yang du bcus par ma gyur na—/ 'bras bu'i tshogs yangs pa ma bsags pa 'di nges par nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis rjoyongs su mya ngan las 'das pas mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro—/ /'bras bu mtha' yas pa'i gnas skabs thob tu zin kyang gal te dus phyis khyasnying rje'i yongs su smin pa dang bral bar gyur na ni 'di dus ring por nye bar longs spyod par mi 'gyur la/ 'phags pa'i 'bras bu'i tshogs chen po rim pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa rnam pa bar rjom chad pa yun ring por mngon par 'phel bar yang mi 'gyur ro/ /da ni dmigs pa'i bye brag la 'jug pa'i sgo nas kyang snying rje'i rang gi ngo bo'i khyad par mngon par ⑦gsal bar byas te de nyid la phyag 'tshal ba brtsam par 'dod pas/ dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur 60—606

zhing / /bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags bskyed pa/ /zo chun 'phyan ①ltar rang dbang med pa yi/ /'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud/ /ces bya ba smos so/ /'jig rten 'di ni bdag gir ①mngon par zhen pa'i snga rol nyid du ngar 'dzin pas yod pa ma yin pa'i bdag yod do snyam du nye bar brtags nas 'di nyid du bden par mngon par zhen cing / 'di ni bdag gi'o snyam du ngar 'dzin pa'i yul las gzhan pa'i dngos po'i rnam pa ma lus pa la mngon par zhen pa yin no/ /bdag dang bdag gir mngon par zhen pa'i 'jig rten 'di ni las dang nyon mongs pa'i thag pas ches dam du bsdams pa/ 'khrul 'khor bskor ①mkhan rnam par shes pa'i bskyod pa la rag las par 'jug pa/ 'khor ba'i khron pa chen po srid pa'i rtse mo nas mnar med pa la thug pa zab la bar dumed par 'phyan pa/ rang gi rang nyid kyis thur dudu 'gro bar 'jug pa 'bad pas ci zhig ltar drang bar bya ba mi shes pa la sogs pa nyon mongs pa dang las dang skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa gsum yod kyang snga ma dang phyi ma dang bar gyi rim pa nges par mi zin pa/ nyi ma re re zhing sdug bsngal gyi (nyasdug bsngal dang /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid dag gis gcog pa'i phyir zo chun khyud mo'i gnas skabs las ma 'das par gnas pa zhig ste/ gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' de'i sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba ⑦de la shin tu snying rjes dmigs nas bskyab par spro ba de'i phyir ches thog ma kho nar bcom ldan 'das ma ⑧snying rje chen po la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ⑨snying rje sems can la dmigs pa'o/ /chos la dmigs pa dang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje yang dmigs pa'i sgo nas gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ 'gro ba g.yo ba'i chu 60—607

yi nang gi zla ba ltar/ /g.yo dang rang bzhin nyid kyis stong par mthong ba yis①/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud/ /ces bya ba de dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /'di ltar chu shin tu dngas pa ②rlung te por drag po ④ma yin pas cha shas brlabs pas khyab pa'i nang du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan sngar dmigs pa'i rten gyi yul dang / lhan cig 'jig pa de dag gi dngos po mngon sum du dmigs pa lta bu ⑤shar ba na/ dam pa dag gis gnyis po 'di rang gi bdag nyid gsal bar byed pa ltar gnas par mthong ste/ 'di lta ste/ skad cig re re la mi rtag pa nyid dang / rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' snying rje'i gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pa rnams kyis kyang sems can 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i mtshor ⑥ma rig pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i ro phul du byung ba 'byung ⑦ba'i rgyu/ phyin ci log 3rtog pa mtha' dag pa'i mtshan nyid—/ 'gro ba yongs kyi ma rig pa'i chu sngon po rgya che ba tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gis rab tu bskyod pa'i nang na gnas pa rang gi las kyi gzugs brnyan lta bur mdun na gnas pa rnams skad cig re re la mi rtag pa'i sdug bsngal thog tu 'bab pa dang / rang bzhin gyis stong par mthong ba na/de dag gi mi rtag pa nyid kyi sdug bsngal 'joms pa lta bur gyur pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i ro phul du byung ba khye 'byung ba'i rgyu/ phyin ci log gi rtog pa mtha' dag log pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'gro ba yongs kyi gnyen nyid kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa sangs rgyas nyid yang dag par thob par 'dod pa yin no/ /de dag gi snying rje sems can la dmigs pa dang / chos la dmigs pa dang / dmigs pa med pa gang yin pa de rnams la rab tu btud nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 60—608

rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi dbye ba rnam pa bcu brjod par 'dod pas ji byang chub kyi sems dang po'i dbang du byas nas/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'di yi sems gang 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam par grol bar bya phyir snying rje'i dbang gyur zhing ①/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam rab bsngos ④dga' ba la/ /rab tu gnas pa de ni dang po zhes bya'o/ /zhes bya ba smos so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zag pa med pa'i ye shes snying rje la sogs pas yongs su zin pa nyid char ①rnam par bye ba nas zhes bya ba'i ming 'thob ste/ yon tan kyi rten du gyur pa'i phyir ro//de yang gong nas gong du yon tan gyi grangs dang / mthu phul du byung ba thob pa dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa klags pa dang / rnam par smin pa 'phel ba'i bye brag gis sa rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i rnam par dbye bas dbye ba rnam pa bcur gzhag gi/ 'di la rang gi ngo bo'i khyad par gyis byas pa'i dbye ba ni yod pa ma yin no/ /ji skad du/ ji ltar bar snang bya rjes mkhas rnams kyis/ /brjod par nus ma yin zhing mi mthong ba/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i sras kyi sa kun kyang / /brjod mi nus na mnyan par ga la nus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu dga' ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa dang po yin la mthar chos kyi sprin ni sems bskyed pa bcu pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' ji skad bshad pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba rang bzhin med par mthong ba snying rje'i khyad par nyid du nye bar gzung ༷ba'i sems gang snying rje'i gzhan gyi dbang du gyur cing ⑤/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i 0na lam gyis yongs su bsngos pa rab tu ⑥dga' ba zhes bya ba'i ming can gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de'i rgyu can byi 'bras bus ④nye 60—609

bar mtshon pa de la ni/ dang po zhes bya bar brjod do/ /de la don lam chen po bcu la sogs pa don lam 'bum phrag grangs med pa phrag bcu po gang dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pas 'debs pa de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi nang du 'dus pa yin te/ don lam ma lus pa nye bar bsdu ①bar bya ba'i phyir kun tu bzang po'i smon lam khyad par gebakod pa yin no/ /de la ji ltar nyan thos kyi theg par zhugs pa dang /'bras bu'i lam la gnas pa'i dbye bas nyan thos kyi sa brgyad rnam par 'jog pa de bzhin du/ theg pa chen por yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu yin no/ /yang ji ltar nyan thos nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i gnas skabs skyed ①pa ni/ 'bras bu dang po la zhugs pa'i gnas skabs yin par mi 'dod pa de bzhin du/ 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' yang yin te/ dkon mchog sprin gye mdo las/ mos pa chen po'i yang chen pos spyod pa'i chos nyid kyi sa dang po de ma thag tu thob rjopar gnas pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi sems ma bskyed pa'i sa'o zhes ji skad gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /mos pas ruspyod pa'i skad cig de la gnas pa yang / rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni mi'i mdog las ni 'das la/ lha'i mdog ni ma thob pa yin te/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang 'jig rten pa dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad las ni bu /shin tu 'das la/ don dam pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa ni ④thob pa yin no zhes de nyid las rnam par bshad do/ /yang gang gi tshe 'di rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i sa dang po la zhugs par gyur pa/ de nas 60—610

bzung ste de ni de thob gyur pa yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'i sgra nyid kyis bsnyad do/ /sems de thob pa ni rnam pa thams cad du so so'i skye bo'i sa las 'das pa'i gnas skabs su byang chub sems dpa'i sgra kho nas brjod par bya ba yin kyi/ rnam pa gzhan gyis ni ma yin te/ de'i tshe de 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du bcom ldan 'das ma nyis stong lnga brgya pa las/byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba ni rjes su rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i tshig bla dwags te/ gang gis chos thams cad rjes su rtogs shing shes pa'o/ /ji ltar shes she na/ ma byung ba dang yang dag par ma byung ba dang log pa dang de dag ji ltar byis pa so so'i skye bo'i ①brtags pa de lta ③ma yin pa dang / ji ltar byis pa so so'i skye bos rnyed pa de lta ①ma yin pa ste/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub ni rnam par ma brtags pa'o/ /byang chub ni ma bsgrubs pa'o/ /byang chub ni dmigs pa med pa'o/ /rab kyi rtsal kyis rnam par gnon pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas ni pebyang chub brnyes pa med de/ chos thams cad ma rnyed ⑤pa'i phyir ro/ /chos thams cad ma dmigs pa'i phyir byang chub ces bya ste/ de lta bu ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ces bya'idu—/ ji skad brjod pa ni ma yin no/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa—/ gang dag byang chub tu sems bskyed cing sems 'di byang chub tu sems ⑦bskyed par bya'o/ /gang du bdag cag gis sems bskyed par bya ba'i byang chub de ni yod do zhes byang chub tu rlom ④sems su byed pa de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes mi bya'o/ /de dag ni skye bar sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar skye ba la mngon par zhen/ sems su mngon par zhen/60—611

byang chub tu mngon par zhen/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /yang byang chub ni mtshan nyid med pa ste/ mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba'o/ /gang gis 'di ltar rjes su rtogs pa de ni byang chub ces bya'i/ yang ji skad brjod pa ni ma yin no/ /rab kyi rtsal byis rnam par gnon pa chos de rnams rtogs pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa gang la la zhig chos 'di ma shes shing rjes su ma rtogs bzhin du bdag nyid la byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'o snyam du shes pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa las ring ba yin zhing / de ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnams las ring ba yin no/ /de bzhin du de ni byang chub sems dpa'i ming gis lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi 'jig rten bslu 7ba yin no/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa 'di ②tshig tsam gyis byang chub sems dpar 'gyur na ni/de bas na sems can thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpar 'gyur na/ rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa 'di ni gang ①gi las tsam ma yin te/ 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa'i sa'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa yin no/ /ji skad du bshad pa'i byang chub kyi sems thob pa ni gnas skabs der byang chub sems dpa'i sgra kho nas brjod pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ gzhan yang / 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rigs su'ang skyes pa ste/ /'di yi kun du sbyor ba gsum po thams cad spangs par gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni dga' ba mchog tu gyur 'chang zhing / /'jig rten khams brgya kun nas g.yo bar nus par gyur pa'ang yin/ /so so'i skye bo dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad las 'das pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa kun du 60—612

'od ces bya ba'i rjes su 'gro ba'i lam skyes pa'i phyir na byang chub sems dpa' de de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes pa yin no/ /de'i tshe gang zag gi bdag med pa mngon sum du mthong bas 'di ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang the tshom dang tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa zhes bya ba kun du sbyor ba gsum dang yang bral ba yin te/ slar mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /de kho na nyid ma ①mthong ba ni bdag tu sgo btags pa las 'jig tshogs su lta bar 'gyur zhing / de bzhin du the tshom gyis de lam gzhan du 'ang 'gro ba srid pa zhig na gzhan ni ma yin no/ /nges pa la zhugs pas de'i zurgyu can gyi yon tan thob pa dang /sa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi skyon dang bral bas thun mong ③ma yin pa'i dga' ba'i khyad par skyes pas rab tu dga' ba mang ba nyid kyi phyir na byang chub sems dpa' de ni dga' ba mchog tu gyur pa srel ba yang yin no/ /rab tu dga' ba khyad par rjo'aphags pa yod pa'i phyir na sa 'dis ni rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i ming yang rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten byi khams brgya bskyod par yang nus so—/ /sa nas sar gnon byed cing gong bar ⑤ rab tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de tshe 'di yi ngan 'gro'i lam rnams mtha' dag 'gags par gyur ⑥/ /de tshe 'di yi so so'i skye bo'i sa rnams thams cad zad/ /'di ni 'phags pa brgyad pa ji lta de ltar nye bar bstan/ /zhes bya ba la 'di ni ji ltar khong du chud pa'i chos la goms pa'i phyir dang / sa gnyis pa la sogs pa la ④gnon pa la spro ba che ba'i phyir sa nas sar gnon pa na gong du rab tu 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /mdor na ji ltar 'phags pa rgyun du zhugs pa la rang dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'phags pa'i chos rtogs pa las skyon dang bral zhing / yon tan 'byung bar gyur pa ⑧de 60—613

bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' 'di la yang sa rtogs pa las rang dang 'tsham pa'i yon tan 'byung ba dang / skyon zad par rgyun du zhugs pa'i dpe'i sgo nas yongs su gsal bar byas pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems lta dang po la gnas kyang / /thub dbang gsung skyes dang bcas rang sangs rgyas rnams ni/ /bsod nams dag gi ①dbang gis pham byas rnam par 'phel/ /zhes bya ba gang yin pa 'di ni khyad par gzhan yin te/ji skad du 'phags pa byams pa'i rnam par thar pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na rgyal po'i bu skyes nas ring por ④ma lon pa rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa ni blon po'i tshogs rgan po gtso bor gyur pa thams cad kyang rigs kyi bdag nyid che ba'i dbang gis zil gyis gnon to/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ring po ma lon pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pas kyang byang chub kyi sems dang /snying rje'i dbang gis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas yun ring du tshangs par spyad pa rnams zil gyis gnon to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chen po'i phru ①gu skyes nas ring po ma lon pa'i gshog pa'i rlung gi shugs dang / mig yongs su dag pa'i yon tan gang yin pa de ni de las gzhan pa'i bya'i tshogs ma lus pa rgas par gyur pa thams cad la yod pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub tu sems dang po bskyed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chen po'i rigs kyi rgyud du yang dag par byung ba nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chen po'i phru ④gu thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa'i gshog pa'i stobs kyis pha rol gnon pa dang /60—614

lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pa'i mig gi yon tan gang yin pa de ni bskal pa brgya stong du ①nges par 'byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad la yod pa ma yin no zhes pa ①la sogs pa gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de ni ring du song bar blo yang lhag par 'gyur/ /'phags pa sa bcu pa las kyang / kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di lta ste/ dper na rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa'i rgyal po'i bu rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa ni skyes pa tsam gyis rgyal po'i byin gyis blon po'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang gi blo'i stobs kyis rnam par dpyad pas ni ma yin no/ /nam de nar son par gyur pa de'i tshe rang gi blo'i stobs bskyed pas blon po'i bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sems bskyed ma thag tu lhag pa'i bsam pa'i che ba nyid kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang gi blo'i stobs kyis rnam par dpyad pas ni ma yin no//byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni rang gi yul shes pa'i che ba la gnas pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa yin no zhes ji skad gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de'i phyir de ltar na ring du song ba kho na nas bzung nas ni byang chub sems dpas rang gi blo'i stobs bskyed pas kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dag zil gyis gnon par 'gyur gyi/ sa 'og ma rnams su ni ma yin no zhes bya bar ①shes par bya'o—/ /lung 'di las ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la yang chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa yang yod do zhes bya bar gsal bar nges te / de ltar ma yin na dngos po rang bzhin med par yongs su shes pa dang 60—615

bral ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba ltar de dag kyang sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpas kyang rang gi blos rnam par dpyad pas kyang zil gyis gnon par 'gyur la/ phyi rol pa bzhin du 'di dag gis khams gsum na spyod pa'i phra rgyas thams cad spangs par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i rang gi ngo bo la dmigs pas phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i phyir gang zag gi bdag med par ①rtogs par yang mi 'gyur te/ bdag tu gdags pa'i rgyu phung po la dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du rin po che'i phreng ba las/ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/ /de srid de la ngar 'dzin nyid/ /ngar 'dzin yod na yang las te/ /de las yang ni skye ba yi④/ /lam gsum thog mtha' dbus med pa/ /'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor mgal me yi/ /dkyil 'khor lta bu phan tshun rmi/ /rgyu can 'di ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ /de ni rang gzhan gnyis ka dang / /dus gsum nyid du'ang ma thob tsaphyir/ /ngar 'dzin pa ni zad par 'gyur/ /de nas las dang skye ba dang / /zhes gsungs so/ /yang ji ltar mig ni 'a la pa yis/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo 'dzin byed pa/ /de bzhin dbang po rnams kyis ni/ /de pelta'i yul dag 'dzin par byed/ /dbang po dang ni dbang don rnams/ /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin 'dod/ /'byung ba so sor don med pas/ /'di dag don du don med do/ /'byung rnams so sor tha dad na/ /bud shing med pa'i mer thal 'gyur/ /'dus na mtshan nyid med 'gyur te/ /lhag ma la yang de ltar nges/ /de ltar 'byung rnams rnam gnyis su'ang / /don med pas na 'dus don med/ /'dus pa don med nyid kyi phyir/ /gzugs kyang don du don med do/ /rnam shes tshor 60—616

dang 'du shes dang / /'du byed rnams kyang thams cad du/ /so sor bdag nyid don med phyir/ /dam pa'i don du don med do/ /ji ltar sdug bsngal phyir bcos la/ /don du bde bar nga rgyal byed/ /de bzhin bde 'joms byung ba la/ /sdug bsngal du yang nga rgyal byed/ /de ltar ngo bo nyid med phyir/ /bde dang phrad pa'i sred pa dang / /sdug bsngal bral ba'i sred pa spong / /de phyir de ltar mthong ba grol/ /gang gis mthong bar 'gyur zhe na/ /tha snyad du ni sems la brjod/ /sems 'byung med par sems med de/ /don med phyir na yod mi 'dod/ /de ltar yang dag ji bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i khyedon med shes nas ni/ /rgyu med pa yi me bzhin du/ /gnas med len med mya ngan 'da'/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ci ste byang chub sems dpa' rnams kho nas de ltar rang bzhin med par mthong ba yin no zhe na/ de yang yod pa ma yin te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang du byas nas de skad du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ji ltar shes she na/ brjod par bya ste/ mjug thogs kho nar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ de ltar byang chub sems dpas kyang / /mthong nas byang chub nges par 'dod/ /'on kyang de ni snying rje yis/ /byang chub bar du srid mtshams sbyor/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs ⑤pa'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos la bstan pa'i mdo dag las kyang / nyan thos rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spang bar bya ba'i phyir/ gzugs ni dbu ba rdos pa 'dra/ /tshor ba chu yi chu bur bzhin/ /'du shes smig rgyu lta bu ste/ /'du byed rnams ni chu shing bzhin/ /rnam par shes pa sgyu ma ltar/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyis bka' stsal to/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas dbu ba rdos pa dang /60—617

chu yi chu bur dang / smig rgyu'i chu dang / chu shing gi phung po dang sgyu ma la sogs pa'i dpe dag gis 'du byed rnams nges par dpyad pa yin no/ /don 'di nyid ston par mdzad pa ni/ slob dpon gyi zhal snga nas kyis/ theg pa che las skye med bstan/ /gzhan kyi dzozad pa stong pa nyid/ /zad dang mi skye don du ni/ /gcig pa de phyir ⑤bzod par gyis/ /zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du / bcom ldan dngos dang dngos med pa/ /mkhyen pas rngukā tā ya na yi/ /gdams thungag las ni yod pa dang / /med pa gnyis ka gdags ⑤pa mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /gang zhig gal te nyan thos kyi theg pa las kyang chos la bdag med pa bstan na de'i tshe theg pa chen po bstan pa don med par 'gyur ro snyam du sems pa de'i lugs de yang 'di ltar rigs pa dang lung dang 'gal bar rtogs so—/ /theg pa chen po bstan pas ni chos la bdag med pa tsam 'ba' zhig ston par byed pa ma yin gyi/ /'o na ci zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa dang / smon lam dang snying rje chen po ( snal sogs pa dang yongs su bsngo ba dang tshogs gnyis dang bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i chos nyid kyang yin no/ /ji skad du rin po che'i phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des④/ /byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur/ /byang chub spyod la gnas pa'i don/ /mdo sde las ni bka' ma sngal/ /theg pa che las bka' sprul pa/ /de phyir mkhas pa rnams kyis gzung ṣ+pe/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos kyi bdag med pa gsal bar bya ba'i phyir theg pa chen po bstan pa yang rigs pa nyid de/ rgyas par bstan pa brjod par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa las ni chos 60—618

kyi bdag med pa mdor mtshon pa tsam zhig tu zad do/ /ji skad du slob dpon rmi zhal snga nas kyis/ mtshan ma med pa ma rtogs par/ /khyod kyis thar pa med par gsungs/ /de phyir khyod kyis theg chen las/ /de ni tshang bar bstan pa lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhar la 'ongs pas chog go/ /de nyid kyi phyir blo ma dkrugs pa rnams kyis rang nyid kyi ①don gyi de kho na nyid khong du chud par nus pas dkyus ma nyid brjod par bya'o/ /de tshe de la rdzogs sangs byang chub rgyur①/ /dang po sbyin pa nyid ni lhag par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa rab tu dga' ba thob pa de la/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan dang shes rab dang / thabs dang smon lam dang / stobs dang ye shes zhes bya ba bcu po dag las sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa kho nas sneches lhag par yod par 'gyur te/ de las ④gzhan rnams med pa ni ma yin no/ /sbyin pa de yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rgyu dang po yin no/ /rang sha ster la'ang gus par byas pa yi/ /snang du mi rung dpog pa'i rgyur yang gyur/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' de'i yon tan snang rung ma yin pas rtogs pa la sogs pa gang dag yin pa de dag kyang phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid kyi dngos po stong pa'i khyad par gyi rjes su dpag pa nyid las gsal bar dpog par byed pa yin te/ du ba la sogs pa las me la sogs pa dag bzhin no/ /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sbyin pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi rgyu dang po dang / mngon sum ma yin pa'i yon tan nges pa'i rtags yin pa de bzhin du/ so so'i skye bo dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa dang / gtan du ba'i bde ba thob pa'i rgyu yin no zhes 60—619

bstan par 'dod pas/ skye bo 'di kun bde ba mngon 'dod cing / /mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la/ /longs spyod kyang ni sbyin las 'byung mdon nas/ /thub pas dang por sbyin pa'i gtam mdzad do/ /zhes bya ba smos pa la/ bkres pa dang skom pa dang nad dang grang ba la sogs pa'i gnyen po—/ sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa tsam srid pa'i bde ba 'byung ba'i rgyu 'ching ba phyin ci log tsam gyis bdag nyid kyi rgyun nye bar brtags pas/ nye bar 'tshe ba bsal ba bde ba'i bdag nyid ma yin pa nyid la 'jig rten shin tu ches ①mngon par zhen la/ de lta bu'i bde ba mngon par 'dod pa de'i bde ba sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa tsam gyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni/ mngon par 'dod pa'i yul longs spyod sdug bsngal kyi gnyen por gyur pa/ phyin ci log gi bdag nyid can longs spyad pa med par skye bar ma dmigs so/ /sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i yul de dag kyang sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ma bsags pa rnams la mi 'byung ngo snyam du mdon nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsam pa'i rang bzhin mdon pas tshul khrims la sogs pa'i gtam rnams pas ches thog mar sbyin pa'i gtam nyid mdzad do/ /da ni stong pa po'i sems can byed dang mi mthun pa yin du zin kyang / rang gi bya ba dang rjes su mthun pas sbyin pa'i bdag nyid chen po brjod par bya ba'i phyir/snying rje dman zhing shin tu tsub sems can/ /rang don lhur len nyid du gyur pa gang / /de dag gi yang 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams/ /sdug bsngal nyer zhi'i rgyur gyur sbyin las byung / /zhes bya ba smos te⑤/ gang dag tshong pa bzhin du nor ches nyung ④ngu btang ba las 'bras bu nor gyi phung po ches yangs pa 'dod pa 60—620

don du gnyer ba bas kyang lhag par don du gnyer bar gyur cing skyesbyin par 'dod par gus kyi/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sras rnams ②ltar snying rje'i gzhan gyi snedabang gis sbyin pa'i 'bras bu rjodon du mi gnyer ba kho nar sbyin par 'dod pa'i dga' ston mngon par 'phel bar mi byed pa de dag la yang / sbyin pa'i ⑤skyon 'dzin pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa yon tan tsam 'dzin pa la g.yer bag thob pa des—/ longs spyod phul du byung ba phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas lus kyi sdug bsngal yid du mi 'ong ba bkres pa dang rjoskom pa la sogs pa 'joms par byed pas sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i rgyur 'byur ro/ /gang zhig snying rje dang bral bas rang gi sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa la ltos pa nyid kyis sbyin par 'dod par gus pa 'di yang / 'di yang sbyin pa'i skabs kyis nam zhig tshe/ /'phags pa'i skye ba ⑦dang phrad myur du 'thob/ /de nas srid rgyun yang dag bcad byas te/ /de yi rgyu can zhi bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba smos so/ /sbyin bdag gtong ba po'i thad du dam pa dag gis bgrod pa yin no zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ sbyin pa la lhag par mos pa ni/ sbyin pa'i skabs kyis 'phags pa'i skye bo dang phrad pas des nye bar bstan pa las 'khor ba la yon tan med par rig cing /'phags pa'i lam dri ma med pa mngon du byas pas sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i ma rig pa spangs nas/ 'khor ba'i rgyun skye ba dang 'chi ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thog ma med pa'i dus nas 'jug pa dor te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta ④na re zhig byang chub sems dpa' ma yin pa rnams kyi sbyin pa 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba thob pa'i rgyu yin no/ /'gro la phan par dam bcas 60—621

yid can rnams/ /sbyin pas ring por mi thogs dga' ba thob①/ /byang chub sems dpa' ma yin pa rnams ni sbyin pa dang dus mnyam du ji skad bshad pa'i spyin pa'i ①'bras bu nges par longs spyod pa ma yin te/ des na de rnams ni sbyin pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum pa ma yin pa nyid kyi phyir sbyin pa la mi 'jug pa yang srid na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sbyin pa dang dus mnyam pa ①kho nar don du gnyer ba'i yid yongs su tshim par byas pa las/ mngon par 'dod pa'i sbyin pa'i rnams bu phun sum tshogs pa rjomachog tu dga' ba 'chang zhing /de nyid du sbyin pa'i rnams bu nye bar longs spyod do/ /de'i phyir dus ⑤thams cad kyi tshe sbyin pa la dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir de ltar ji skad bshad pa'i byed gyes/ gang phyir brtse bdag brtse bdag ma yin pa/ /thams cad kyi mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i rgyu sbyin pa yin pa/ de phyir sbyin pa'i gtam nyid rtsa ba duyin/ /gang las de rnams dus rtag tu sbyin pa la gus par 'gyur ba/ don du gnyer ba rnams longs spyod kyis rnam par 'god ⑦pa'i sgo nas yid byed par byed pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la dga' ba'i khyad par skye ba ko ci 'dra ba zhig ce na/ brjod par bya ste/ ji ltar byin cig ces sgra thos bsams las/ /rgyal sras bde 'byung de ltar thub rnams la⑧/ /zhi bar zhugs pas bde ba byen min na/ /thams cad btang bas lta zhig smos ci dgos/ /re zhig don du gnyer ba rnams kyis ④byin cig ces bya ba'i sgra thos pa nyid sems par byed pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di dag ni bdag la slong ba zhig go snyam du rtogs nas yang nas yang du bde ba 'byung ba gang yin pa de nyid ji mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba bas kyang phul du byung ba 60—622

dang bcas pa yin na/ phyi dang nang gi dngos po btang bas/ don du gnyer ba'i skye bo tshim par byed pa rnams kyi lta ci ①smos/ yang ci gang las de skad brjod pa phyi dang nang gi dngos po gtong ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la lus kyi sdug bsngal yang mi 'byung ngam zhe na/ bshad pa/ bdag nyid chen po rnams la ni sems med pa rnams bcad pa ltar lus kyi sdug bsngal 'byung ba mi srid pa nyid de/ 'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin las/ 'di lta ste/ dper na shing sā ④la chen po'i tshal zhig yod la/ der 'ga' zhig 'ongs nas sā ①la gcig bcad pa na/ der shing sā rjol lhag ma de rurnams 'di snyam du 'di ni bcad pa'o/ /bdag cag ni ma bcad pa'o snyam du mi sems shing /de dag la rjes su chags pa dang khong khro ba med do/ /rtog ④pa dang / rnam par rtog pa med do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa de lta bu gang yin pa de ni bzod pa yongs su dag pa mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yin no zhes ji skad gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /rin po che'i phreng ba las kyang / de la lus kyi sdug bsngal med/ /yid kyi sdug bsngal ga la yod/ /de ni snying rjes 'jig rten sdug/de nyid kyis ni yun ring gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang chags pa med pa'i gnas skabs ma thob pa gang zhig la lus gnas pa dang 'gal ba'i yul yang dag par babs pas lus kyi sdug bsngal gdon mi za bar 'byung ba de'i tshe ④de yang sems can gyi don bya ba dag ⑧ la ches lhag par 'jug pa'i rgyu nyid du gnas pa yin no zhes bshad pa ni/ lus bcad ster zhing bdag gi sdug bsngal gyis/ /gzhan dag rnams kyi dmyal ba la sogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal rang rig nyid du mthong nas de/ /de gcad bya phyir myur du brtson 'grus rtsom/ /zhes bya ba ⑨ste/60—623

byang chub sems dpa' ni sdug bsngal can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten la sogs pa'i 'gro ba mi bzad par chud pa bar mtshams med par sdug bsngal ches drag pas lus 'joms pa rang gi lus gcod pa'i sdug bsngal bas stong 'gyur bas kyang ches lhag par 'phel ba'i sbug bsngal bsran du med pa dang ldan pa dag la rang gi sdug bsngal myong ba nyid du lta ba na rang gi lus gcod pa'i sdug bsngal la/ rtsis med par byas nas sems can rnams kyi dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gcod ①par bya ba'i phyir ches myur du brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /ji skad bshad pa'i sbyin pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnam par dbye ba bstan pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos stong ༄1 / /'jig rten 'das pa'i pha rol phyin zhes bya/ /zhes bya ba smos te/de la pha rol zhes bya ba ni gang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i phar 'gram dang ngogs te/nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus pa spangs pa'i rang bzhin mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas nyid do/ /pha rol du son pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes bya ste/tshig phyi ma yod na mi mngon par mi bya'o zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid 'dis zhulas kyi rnam par dbye ba mi mngon par ma byas pas gzugs su 'gyur ba'am/ pre ṣe da ra la sogs pa yin pa'i phyir phyi ma'i mtha' can nyid du gzhag go/ /shes rab bzung nas bye brag tu bshad pa yin te/ sbyin pa la sogs pa rnams ni pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'dra bas pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /yongs su bsngo ba'i khyad par gyis pha rol tu 'gro ba la nges par gzhag nas ni sbyin pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims la sogs pa 'chad par 'gyur ba dag kyang de bzhin du rig par bya'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'i sbyin pa 60—624

—byed— ———'di yang sbyin par bya ba dang / len pa po dang / sbyin pa por dmigs par bya ba ①dang bral bar grur na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gsungs te—/ mi dmigs pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phyir la/ dmigs pa ni tha snyad kyi bden pas ①bsdus pa nyid kyi phyir ①'jig rten pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro—/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs ma thob pa dag gis shes par mi nus so/ /gzhan yang / gsum po dag la ④chags skyes gyur pas de/ /'jig rten pa yi pha rol phyin zhes bstan/ /sbyin pa de nyid gsum du dmigs pa yod na 'jig rten pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya bar bsnyad do/ /da ni ji skad brjod pa'i sa zhes bya ba shes pa'i khyad par gyi phul du byung ba'i yon tan rjes su brjod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i phyir/ de ltar rgyal ba'i sras kyi yid la rab gnas shing / /dam pa'i rten la 'od chags mdzes pa rnyed gyur pa'i/ /dga' ba 'di ni nor bu chu shel ji bzhin du/ /mun pa stug po thams cad rnam par bsal nas rgyal/ /zhes bya ba smos so/ /de ltar gyi sgra ni ji skad bshad pa'i rnam pa bstan par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /dga' ba zhes bya ba ni sa'i ming yang dag par sgrogs ⑤pa'o/ /rgyal zhes bya ba ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs pham par byas nas gnas so zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de ni shes pa'i rang bzhin yin pa nyid kyis 4rgyal ba'i sras kyi yid la gnas pa'i phyir mthon por gnas pa yin te/ sa rab tu dga' ba ni ji skad bshad pa'i tshul gyis mun pa stug po thams cad kyang rnam par bsal ⑦te rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /ji skad bshad pa'i don nyid dpes gsal ④bar bya ba'i phyir smras pa ni/ nor bu chu shel ji ⑨bzhin du 60—625

—zhes bya ba'o/ /dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bshad pa las rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba sems bskyed pa dang po'o / /①byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa dang po bshad zin to // //②da ni gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de tshul phun tshogs yon tan dag ldan phyir/ /rmi lam du yang 'chal khrims dri ma spangs/ /zhes bya ba smos te/sa zhes bya ba shes pa'i khyad par thams cad ni rang bzhin gcig pa nyid kyi phyir/de med na ④mi 'byung ba'i yon tan tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa phul du byung ba nyid las sems bskyed pa gnyis pa la sogs pa'i khyad par ston par byed do/ /de la nyon mongs pa dang du mi rjolen pa'i phyir dang / sdig pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir sems yid la gcags ⑤pa'i me zhi bas bsil ba nyid kyi phyir ram—/ bde ba'i rgyu yin pa nyid kyis dam pa dag gis bsten rjopar bya ba nyid kyi phyir na tshul khrims te ⑦de yang spong ba bdun kyi mtshan nyid can no/ /chos gsum po ma chags pa dang zhe sdang med pa dang yang dag pa'i lta ba ni de dag kun nas slong bar byed pa yin te/ de'i phyir kun nas slong bar byed pa dang bcas pa'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas nas las kyi lam bcur rnam par bshad do/ /tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa ni tshul khrims rab tu gyur pa'o/ /yon tan rnam par dag pa ni yon tan dag pa ste/ tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa yongs su dag pa zhes bya bar tshig rnam par sbyar ro/ /rang gi yon tan yongs su dag pa nyid kyi phyir tshul khrims nyid khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /de dang ldan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' de ni rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su yang tshul khrims 60—626

'chal ba'i dri ma dag gis mi gos pa'o/ /yang ji ltar na de de ltar tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pas ①yon tan yongs su dag par 'gyur zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa la rab tu gnas pa 'di ni/ lus ngag yid kyi rgyu ba dag gyur pas/ /dam pa'i las lam bcu char ②sogs par byed/ /ji skad du byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa las/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa'i sa dri ma med pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni rang bzhin gyis srog gcod pa spangs pa yin te/ dbyig pa spangs/ mtshon cha spangs/ 'khon du 'dzin pa spangs nas/ 'dzem pa dang ldan zhing snying rje la zhugs pas/ de srog chags 'byung po thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba dang / snying brtse ba dang / byams pa'i sems dang ldan te/ de kun du rtog pa tsam gyis kyang / srog chags la rnam par 'tshe bar mi byed na/ sems can gzhan la sems can du 'du shes shing ched du bsams te/ lus kyi ①mtho 'tshalas ④pa chen po bya ba lta ci smos/ ma byin par sdelen pa spangs pa yang yin te/ bdag gi longs spyod kyis chog shes shing snying brtse ba dang ldan te/ gzhan gyi longs spyod la bag byed pas de gzhan dugyis yongs su bzung ba'i dngos po dag la gzhan gyis bzung bar 'du shes shing /rku sems nye bar gzhag ste tha na rtswa dang lo ma tsam yang ma byin par mi len na/'tsho ba'i yo byad gzhan dag lta ci smos/ 'dod pa la log par g.yem pa spangs pa yang yin te/ bdag gi chung mas chog shes shing / gzhan gyi chung ma la 'dod pa med pas/ de gzhan gyis bzung ba'i bud med gzhan gyi chung ma dang /rus dang / mtshan dang / chos kyis bsrungs pa rnams la chags sems kyang 60—627

———byedami bskyed na/ yan lag ma yin pa'i rnam par rig byed dam/ gnyis kyi dbang po gnyis sprod pa lta ci smos/ brdzun du smra ba spangs pa yang yin te/bden par smra be+e/nga yang dag par smra la/ dus su smra ste/ ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed pa'o/ /de tha na rmi lam na yang lta ba dang bzod pa dang 'dod pa dang rab tu rtog pa ①bsgyur te/ bslu ba'i bsam pas brdzun ②gyi tshig mi smra na/ched du bsams te smra ba lta ci smos/ phra ma'i tshig spangs pa yin te/ sems can rnams la dbyen mi byed cing / rnam par mi 'tshe ba la zhugs pas/ des 51de dag dbye ba'i phyir tshu gi las thos nas pha gir snyod pa ma yin te/ de dag dbye ba'i phyir pha gi las thos nas tshu gir snyod pa ma yin te/ 'dum pa rnams mi 'byed cing / bye ba rnams la yang mi gnon ④te/ mi 'dum pa la dga' zhing mi 'dum pa la mos pa ma yin pas⑤/ bden nam brdzun yang mi 'dum par bya ba'i tshig mi smra'o/ /tshig rtsub mo spangs pa yin te/ zher 'debs pa dang / brlang pa dang / gzhan la gnod pa dang / gzhan byi mtshang 'bru ba dang / grong mi'i tshig dang / ma rabs kyi tshig ngor brjod pa dang / ngor brjod par gzhol ba dang / brdzun dang rnar mi snyan pa dang / khro zhing gshe ba las byung ba dang / mi snyan pa dang / yid du mi 'ong bas snying na bar byed pa dang / yid gdung bar byed pa dang / rang gi sems kyi rgyud dhidang /ga'an gyi sems kyi rgyud ma rungs par byed pa'i tshig rnam pa ⑦de lta bu spangs te/gang 'di mnyen blupa dang / 'jam pa dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / brdzun du ma yin pa dang / rnar snyan pa dang / snying du sdug pa dang / grong byed pa dang / skye bo mang po'i snying du sdug pa dang / skye bo mang po'i yid du 'ong ba 60byed628

dang / yid dga' bar byed pa dang / yid tshim par byed pa dang / rang gi sems kyi rgyud dang / gzhan gyi sems kyi rgyud dang bar byed pa'i tshig rnam pa de lta bu dag brjod do/ /tshig 'khyal hu pa spangs pa yin te/ lan legs par glon ①pa'i tshig dang / dus su smra ba dang / yang dag par smra ba dang /don smra ba dang / chos smra ba dang / rigs par smra ba dang / dul bar smra ba dang / bzod ①pa dang ldan pa dang / dus dang rmed dang bcas pa'i tshig smra ba yin te/ de tha na bzhad gad du bya ba'i yongs su spang bar bya ba yang yongs su spong na/ tshig gis rnam par g.yeng ba lta ci smos/ brnab sems med pa yang yin te/ de gzhan gyi nor dang / gzhan gyi 'dod pa dang / gzhan gyi rdzas dang / yo byad gzhan gyis yongs su bzung ba la/ brnab sems mi bskyed la/chags par ④mi byed la/ mi rton te/ chags pa'i sems mi bskyed do/ /gnod sems med pa yang ⑤yin te/ sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems dang / snying rje'i sems dang / bde ba'i sems dang / 'jam pa'i sems dang / skye bo thams cad la phan gdags pa'i sems dang ldan pas khong khro ba dang / 'khon du 'dzin pa dang / tha ba dang / dri ma dang / gnod sems dang / khong khro ba sngon du 'gro ba gang dag yin pa de dag spangs te/ byams pa dang ldan pa gang dag yin pa de dag rtog pa yin no/ /log par lta ba spangs pa yang yin te/ yang dag par lta bar gyur la yang dag pa'i lam la gnas shing / dge mtshan dang bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs dang / tshul khrims ngan pa'i lta ba can dang bral ba yin te/ lta ba drang zhing g.yo med la sgyu med pas/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 60—629

'dun la bsam pa nges pa yin no zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de la dge ba'i las kyi lam dang po gsum ni lus kyis ①rdzogs par byed do/ /bar gyi bzhi ni ngag gis so/ /tha ma gsum ni yid kyis so/ /de ltar na dge ba'i las lam bcu char skeyang sog par byed pa yin no/ /yang ci las kyi lam 'di rnams sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpas mi sog ①gam zhe na/des kyang sog ④mod kyi 'on kyang / dge ba'i lam 'di lta zhig bcu char ⑤yang //de la klags te shin tu dag par 'gyur/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa la ni ma yin no/ /ston ka'i zla ltar rtag tu rnam dag ste/ /zhi 'od chags par de dag gis rnam mdzes/ /zhi ba ni dbang po bsdams pa'o/ /'od chags pa ni lham mer gsal ba'i lus can nyid do/ /de ltar tshul khrims yongs su dag pa yin yang / gal te de ni khrims dag rang bzhin lta/ /de phyir de ni tshul khrims dag mi 'gyur/ /ji skad du/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ 'od srungs 'di la dge slong kha cig tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin te/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pas bsdams shing gnas/ cho ga dang spyod yul phun sum tshogs pa kha na ma tho ba phra rab rnams la yang 'jig tshupar lta ba⑦/yang dag par blangs te bslab pa'i gzhi rnams la slob cing lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las yongs su dag pa dang ldan par gyur pas 'tsho ba yongs su dag kyang 3bdag tu smra ba yin te/ 'od srungs de ni tshul khrims 'chal pa/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa ltar bcos pa dang po zhes bya ba nas/ 'od srungs gzhan yang 'di la dge slong kha cig sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yang dag par blangs kyang /dmigs par lta ba yin te/ ngar 'dzin pa dang nga yir 'dzin pa la gnas pa de 60—630
